name: local llama
author: mihai
description: Load, unload and download local llama.cpp model servers from the Omarchy bar. Fourteen presets are verified to emit real OpenAI tool calls and so work as opencode models (Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B/14B, OxCoder-9B, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, Gemma 4 E2B, gpt-oss-20b, Spark-X2.5 1.7B/4B, Qwen3.5-9B Kimi-k3, Underdog Saluki 27B, LFM2.5-2.6B, MiniCPM5-2B); four more ship as chat-only launchers because they don't survive tool calling. The panel marks each preset downloaded or missing, badging how much lands in VRAM, and fetches a missing GGUF with one click. Nothing occupies RAM or VRAM until you pick a model and click Load, and an optional idle timer lets a resident model sleep on its own.

barWidget.description: Start/stop local llama.cpp servers and show which model is currently loaded for opencode.

schema.label: Auto-sleep a loaded model after idle (seconds, 0 = off)
